lines.text: A bird does not land in a snare without bait, and people tremble when a ram's horn sounds.
The Lord GOD reveals His plan to the priests, and when the lion roars, who will not fear?
Ashdod and Egypt are told to assemble on Samaria's mountains, and an enemy will surround the land.
The LORD will punish Israel and destroy the altars of Gilgal, cutting off the horns of the altar.
